Purpose, projects & practical questions

The work behind
the words.

I connect technology to operations, adoption and the people making decisions. Here is the direction of that work.

01

ECHUKU

The place where the work comes together.

My primary focus is designing digital systems around actual organisational needs: business software, automation, websites, portals and practical AI adoption. I start with how work moves between people and build towards a clearer, more usable process.

Visit ECHUKU →
02

DZEVA

Making everyday AI workflows more approachable.

DZEVA is my evolving AI platform project. Its history includes ECHUKU AI and Falzz. The direction is practical: helping people connect AI tools to useful tasks rather than navigate complexity for its own sake. Earlier Falzz coverage is preserved in the media archive as historical context, not as a guarantee of current features.

Explore DZEVA →
03

KONTA

A clearer view of business operations.

KONTA is my ERP/POS project direction, concerned with sales, inventory, roles and reporting. The problem is familiar: different people hold different parts of the same business story. My aim is to help them work from a shared, understandable record. Specific deployment capabilities and results need their own evidence.

Read the thinking behind it →
04

Education & fellowship

Helping you turn curiosity into capability.

The AI Career Guide and Anzolo Hope AI Fellowship Membership community support people exploring practical AI adoption and career possibilities. The free community invitation begins with the guide request. The emphasis is learning, practice and human judgement.

Start with the free guide →
05

Model exploration

A public record of experimentation.

The GlemVNT/VNT-3.5F-16K repository records model work based on Google’s Gemma 2B. A historical model-card commit describes Hugging Face AutoTrain and manual evaluation. It is a research and experimentation reference, not proof of a model trained from scratch or a validated performance benchmark.

View the model repository →

Business and community contexts

My work has included digital systems for retail, events, care services, education and community organisations. Public reporting discusses earlier relationships involving The Meat Mill and TAKTAL. PLEO Reachout also lists my web-development role on its public website.
